home.heroTitle: Nurturing Global Citizens, One Student at a Time
home.heroSubtitle: A world-class international education in Myanmar — from Early Years to High School, where students learn in English and Burmese, grow in confidence, and become caring leaders of tomorrow.
home.welcomeText: At Hope International School, we believe every child is unique. Our caring teachers, modern facilities and a balanced international curriculum help each student discover their strengths, think critically and act with kindness. We are proud to bring together the best of international education and Myanmar culture — so our students are ready for the world, wherever it takes them.
home.programsSubtitle: A complete learning journey from age 2 to 18, built around international standards.

about.title: About Us
about.intro: Hope International School is a vibrant learning community in Myanmar where international standards meet local values. Since our founding, we have grown into a school of over 500 students from Early Years to Grade 12, guided by a passionate team of local and international educators.
about.missionText: To nurture confident, compassionate and curious learners who think critically, communicate clearly and contribute positively to their community and the wider world.
about.visionText: To be the leading international school in Myanmar — a place where every student is known, valued and inspired to reach their full potential.

values.title: Respect
values.desc: We honour every person, culture and idea, and treat others with kindness and fairness.

values.title: Integrity
values.desc: We act honestly and take responsibility for our words and actions.

values.title: Excellence
values.desc: We set high standards, work hard and always try to improve.

values.title: Community
values.desc: We care for one another and work together — students, families and staff.

about.gallerySubtitle: Moments from our classrooms, playgrounds and celebrations.

academics.title: Academics
academics.intro: Our curriculum blends international teaching standards with the best of Myanmar culture. Students learn to think deeply, ask questions and apply their knowledge to real life.
academics.curriculumText: Our programmes are built on internationally recognised standards and taught in English, with Myanmar language and culture as an integral part of every student's day.
curriculumPoints: Myanmar language, history and culture classes
Hands-on science, technology and arts programmes
Character education woven into daily learning
Small class sizes with individual attention

levels.name: Early Years
levels.desc: Play-based learning that builds curiosity, language and social skills.

levels.name: Primary School
levels.desc: Strong foundations in reading, writing, mathematics, science and creativity.

levels.desc: Deeper subject knowledge, research skills and growing independence.

levels.name: High School
levels.desc: Advanced studies preparing students for international examinations and universities.

admissions.title: Admissions
admissions.intro: We welcome applications throughout the year. Our team will guide you through every step — from your first campus tour to your child's first day.

steps.title: Visit or Contact Us
steps.desc: Book a campus tour or get in touch with our admissions office.

steps.title: Submit Application
steps.desc: Complete the application form with your child's details and documents.

steps.title: Assessment & Interview
steps.desc: Your child joins a friendly assessment and a family interview with our team.

steps.title: Offer of Place
steps.desc: Successful applicants receive an offer letter and enrolment pack.

steps.title: Enrolment
steps.desc: Complete the paperwork, pay the fees, and welcome to Hope!
